newsitem.title: UK: MAM to sell its Swiss bank to Safra.
newsitem.headline: MAM to sell its Swiss bank to Safra.

text.p: British fund manager Mercury Asset Management (MAM) said on Monday it had agreed to sell its Swiss private banking unit Mercury Bank AG to Luxembourg-based Safra Republic Holdings SA for about 250 million Swiss francs cash.

The transaction, which a joint statement from the companies said was due to close by the end of February 1997, is part of MAM's stated strategy to concentrate on its core expertise of investment management, including its UK and Jersey based international private client business.
"Separately, RNB Suisse has appointed MAM to manage a significant pool of assets for its clients in equity and bond markets worldwide.
"For its part, MAM will introduce to RNB Suisse those of its clients requiring the benefits of a Swiss banking service," the statement added.
